text:
As for the ultimate questions that history and philosophy pose, Will Durant says: “Sixty years ago I knew everything. Now I know nothing. Education is a progressive discovery of our own ignorance.”

(source: https://t.co/ps9Nw3h2ZF)

"Other studies may tell us how man might behave, or how he should behave; history tells us how he has behaved for six thousand years."

"It is, as Napoleon said on St. Helena, “the only true philosophy and the only true psychology.”

- Will Durant https://t.co/pf5dccJ9Nx
